name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for an accessible kitchen renovation, look for one with demonstrated experience in accessible design and construction, as it requires specialized knowledge beyond standard remodels. Verify their licensing and insurance. Review their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references. A good contractor will communicate clearly, understand your specific needs, and provide a transparent, detailed proposal. City Dweller, LLC has expertise in creating functional and beautiful accessible kitchens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specialized experience in accessible design, verified licensing, and good references. They should communicate clearly and understand your specific needs.
